_meta.name: HIP acceptance requirements knowledge base
_meta.purpose: Curated standard of HIP acceptance scenarios so the skill is self-contained: it does not need an external test plan to know what SHOULD be tested. Each entry is matched against (a) the target source's API usage and (b) what the local/peer test corpus already covers, to decide whether to PROPOSE the test. Grows over time.

classes.MUST-PASS: Hard baseline; capability officially supported. Missing => FAIL, not skip.
classes.CONDITIONAL: Version/capability gated; skip allowed but log reason + record gate.
classes.REGRESSION: Targets a known issue; a hang/timeout/crash is the signal.

_meta.fields: id, title, area, class, gate, signal_apis[], sequence[], known_issue, description, verify, impl_hint, provenance_hint

requirements.title: HipMalloc_Free_Integrity
requirements.description: Baseline device-memory floor: allocate with hipMalloc, write a known pattern from a GPU kernel, copy back, verify. If this fails nothing else matters.
requirements.verify: Pattern read back matches written; no HIP error.
requirements.impl_hint: Single GPU. Tiny kernel filling buf[i]=seed+i; compare on host.

requirements.title: HostAlloc_Pinned
requirements.description: Allocate/free pinned host memory used for host-side backup buffers; verify host-accessible and a device pointer is obtainable.
requirements.verify: Device sees host writes via the mapped device pointer.
requirements.impl_hint: Flags hipHostMallocMapped; optionally WriteCombined/Uncached variants.

requirements.title: Vmm_Granularity
sequence: round a size up to it
requirements.description: Verify hipMemGetAllocationGranularity returns a non-zero minimum granularity for a Pinned+Device POSIX-fd allocation prop and that size rounding to that granularity is consistent. The first call in every VMM flow, so a regression here breaks all VMM tests downstream.
requirements.verify: Granularity > 0; size rounding is consistent.
requirements.impl_hint: Same prop used by Vmm_Create_Map_Roundtrip.

requirements.title: Vmm_SetGetAccess
sequence: assert RW reported for the device
requirements.description: After hipMemSetAccess with read-write protection, verify hipMemGetAccess reports read-write for the device. Confirms access descriptors are applied and queryable, not silently dropped.
requirements.verify: GetAccess returns read-write for the device.
requirements.impl_hint: Extends the Create_Map flow with an explicit get-access check.

requirements.title: Vmm_Negative_ZeroSize_Unaligned
requirements.description: Negative paths: a zero-size hipMemCreate and an unaligned hipMemAddressReserve must return a clean HIP error code without crashing. Confirms argument validation, not undefined behavior.
requirements.verify: Both calls return an error code; process does not crash.
requirements.impl_hint: Negative-path test; assert error, not success.

requirements.title: Vmm_Uncached_Type
requirements.description: Create, map, and run a write/read integrity check on a VMM allocation declared with hipMemAllocationTypeUncached, the cache-bypassing buffer type. Confirms the uncached allocation path is honored without corruption.
requirements.verify: Data integrity on the uncached buffer; SKIP if unsupported.
requirements.impl_hint: Gate on uncached type support.

requirements.title: MallocAsync_FreeAsync
requirements.description: Stream-ordered allocation: hipMallocAsync and hipFreeAsync on a non-blocking stream followed by a stream synchronize, with a write/read integrity check. SKIP if the device does not advertise memory-pool support. Backs the async allocator path.
requirements.verify: Integrity holds; SKIP if no mempool support.
requirements.impl_hint: Non-blocking stream.

requirements.title: MemPool_Alloc
requirements.description: Create an explicit memory pool (hipMemPoolCreate), allocate from it (hipMallocFromPoolAsync), use it, and destroy the pool (hipMemPoolDestroy). SKIP if the device does not advertise memory-pool support.
requirements.verify: Pool alloc/use/destroy succeed; SKIP if no mempool support.
requirements.impl_hint: Base mempool lifecycle; MemPool_SetAttribute extends it.

requirements.title: Vmm_Create_Map_Roundtrip
requirements.description: Full virtual-memory-management lifecycle on raw HIP. The core primitive RCCL's memory manager (suspend/resume) is built on.
requirements.verify: Data integrity through the mapped VA; clean teardown with no leak/err.
requirements.impl_hint: Use POSIX-fd handle type. This is a SEQUENCE test: hip-tests unit-tests each call, acceptance tests the whole chain.

requirements.title: Vmm_GpuDirectRDMACapable_MultiMap
requirements.description: Allocate+map 16 VMM buffers with gpuDirectRDMACapable=1; assert no crash. Without the flag hipMemMap SIGSEGVs after several allocations. Add a flag=0 variant to check whether the SIGSEGV still reproduces.
requirements.verify: No SIGSEGV after repeated maps; flag=0 variant documents current driver behavior.
requirements.impl_hint: STRESS/scale test (loop). The =0 variant is the regression probe.

requirements.title: Vmm_PosixFd_Export_Import
requirements.description: Export a VMM allocation to a POSIX fd, import on a peer, map, verify data across the import. Backs cross-rank peer buffer sharing.
requirements.verify: Importer reads the exporter's written pattern.
requirements.impl_hint: Multi-process; needs an OOB channel (socket/MPI) to pass the fd (SCM_RIGHTS for true cross-process fd).

requirements.title: Vmm_Fabric_Export_Import
requirements.description: Export/import a fabric handle, map, verify. SKIP when driver/topology reports fabric handles unsupported.
requirements.verify: Data visible across fabric import, or coordinated skip.
requirements.impl_hint: Gate on fabric-handle support probe.

requirements.title: Vmm_Map_NoDeadlock_KernelInFlight
sequence: launch kernel spinning on null stream polling a host flag
host: hipMemMap on a separate VMM alloc under watchdog
then set flag to release kernel
requirements.description: hipMemMap is documented host-only but CLR waits synchronously; with a collective kernel in flight the wait is transitively gated by that kernel -> closed dependency cycle that deadlocked multi-segment IPC registration at >=8 ranks. A hang/timeout is the regression signal.
requirements.verify: hipMemMap/Unmap return within the watchdog window.
requirements.impl_hint: Needs a watchdog thread; the kernel must busy-wait on a host-set flag.

requirements.title: Ipc_Legacy_GetOpen_RoundTrip
sequence: publish 64-byte handle via shm_open/mmap (handle is byte-copyable)
requirements.description: REAL cross-process (separate address spaces, not in-process, not just MPI-rank) legacy IPC: the hipIpc mem handle is a byte-copyable blob, so it can travel through shared memory between forked processes. RCCL keeps this path as a fallback beside VMM-fd.
requirements.verify: The other PROCESS reads the originator's pattern through the opened handle; closing on both sides is clean.
requirements.impl_hint: True multi-process via fork()+shm_open/mmap (or exec). Handle copies by value. Mirror hip-tests multiproc/hipIpcMemAccessTest.cc (mmap MAP_SHARED + sem_post handoff). Contrast HIPACC-021/022 where the handle is NOT byte-copyable.

requirements.title: Vmm_PosixFd_CrossProcess_pidfd
sequence: proc0: VMM alloc (hipMemCreate POSIX-fd) + write pattern
pidfd_getfd(pidfd, fd, 0) -> local fd (the POSIX fd is NOT byte-copyable across processes)
requirements.description: REAL cross-process sharing of a VMM POSIX-fd allocation. Unlike the legacy hipIpc handle, a POSIX fd is a per-process object and cannot be memcpy'd between processes -> it must be transferred (pidfd_getfd, or SCM_RIGHTS over a unix socket). This is the actual mechanism rocSHMEM uses. The most regression-prone cross-process path (depends on kernel pidfd support + ptrace yama policy).
requirements.verify: Importer PROCESS reads exporter's pattern through the imported+mapped fd. SKIP with reason if pidfd_getfd unavailable.
requirements.impl_hint: proc0 calls prctl(PR_SET_PTRACER, PR_SET_PTRACER_ANY) so proc1 may pidfd_getfd it. Alternative transfer: SCM_RIGHTS over AF_UNIX socket. Do NOT just pass the integer fd value across processes - that is a different (wrong) fd in proc1.

requirements.title: Vmm_Fabric_CrossProcess
requirements.gate: ROCm>=7.12; fabric handles supported by driver/topology
sequence: publish the fabric handle bytes via shm/socket/OOB
requirements.description: REAL cross-process sharing via a fabric handle. Unlike the POSIX fd, a fabric handle IS byte-copyable and process/node-portable (no pidfd/SCM_RIGHTS needed) - the contrast case. SKIP when fabric handles are unsupported.
requirements.verify: Importer PROCESS reads exporter's pattern; coordinated skip if fabric unsupported.
requirements.impl_hint: Same handoff as a plain blob (it is just bytes), but gate on fabric support. The point of this test vs HIPACC-021 is to prove the fabric path works WITHOUT fd transfer.

requirements.title: Event_DisableTiming_CrossStream_Sync
requirements.description: Lazy cross-stream dependency RCCL installs on a detected stream change. The chain (not the single call) is the scenario.
requirements.verify: B observes A's write; regression = B proceeds early.
requirements.impl_hint: Two streams; event with timing disabled.

requirements.title: Launch_DynShared_FuncAttr
requirements.description: Per-device kernel init: raise the dynamic shared-memory cap then launch using it. A regression silently caps collective shared memory.
requirements.verify: Kernel launches and runs with the raised dyn-shmem; no launch error.
requirements.impl_hint: Set opt-in shmem above the static default.

requirements.title: Ce_BatchCopy_Ordered
requirements.description: Runtime-gated CE batch-copy path with event ordering. SKIP+reason outside the supported driver range. A prime FW/driver regression candidate.
requirements.verify: Batched result correct; coordinated skip when gate not met.
requirements.impl_hint: Replicate ncclCeBatchAsyncSupported() version check verbatim.

requirements.title: Device_CanAccessPeer_Matrix
requirements.description: P2P capability matrix across all GPU pairs on a node, then a peer copy. RCCL disables an LL optimization if any pair lacks P2P.
requirements.verify: Reported matrix matches achievable peer copies.
requirements.impl_hint: Multi-GPU single-node; clear hipGetLastError after enable.

requirements.title: Gdr_HandleForAddressRange_Export
requirements.description: The HIP->Verbs handoff: obtain a dmabuf fd+offset for a GPU buffer for NIC GDR registration. Foundational for HIP/Verbs MIXED scenarios.
requirements.verify: Valid fd+offset returned; later registerable by ibv_reg_dmabuf_mr (mixed test).
requirements.impl_hint: dlopen/dlsym the hsa symbol; skip if absent.

requirements.title: Capture_Dependency_Update_Chain
requirements.description: Splice ordering into a captured graph using the versioned capture-dependency APIs, with the v2/non-v2 fallback RCCL carries.
requirements.verify: Captured graph runs with the injected dependency; correct result.
requirements.impl_hint: Gate on availability of the _v2/_v3 entry points.

requirements.title: Symbol_Version_Detection
requirements.description: Dependency-tracking floor: report ROCm/HIP/driver versions and which optional symbols (hsa_amd_portable_export_dmabuf, cuMem family) resolve. Establishes version as a reported test dimension.
requirements.verify: Versions reported; per-symbol presence table emitted (never fails, informational baseline).
requirements.impl_hint: This test also gates many CONDITIONAL tests; run it first.

requirements.title: Device_Query_Basics
requirements.description: Basic device enumeration/selection floor RCCL does at init. Smoke: enumerate, select, read properties, PCI-bus-id round-trips.
requirements.verify: Count>0; set/get device consistent; PCI bus id maps back to the same device.
requirements.impl_hint: Pure smoke, single-node. No transfer.

requirements.title: DeviceSetLimit_StackSize
sequence: launch a kernel that uses deep stack
requirements.description: RCCL raises the device stack-size limit before launching kernels. Verify the limit is accepted and a stack-heavy kernel runs.
requirements.verify: SetLimit returns success; kernel runs correctly under the raised limit.
requirements.impl_hint: cudaLimitStackSize equivalent; RCCL sets it ignoring errors.

requirements.title: Event_Timing_Query_Elapsed
requirements.description: Timing-enabled events (contrast HIPACC-030 which disables timing): record around a kernel, query completion, measure elapsed ms.
requirements.verify: hipEventQuery reports complete after sync; elapsed time is a sane positive value.
requirements.impl_hint: Timing path differs from disable-timing path; both must work.

requirements.title: HostRegister_Mapped_RoundTrip
requirements.description: Register existing (non-pinned) host memory for device access — the SHM path RCCL uses. Distinct from hipHostMalloc.
requirements.verify: Device writes through the registered mapping are visible on the host buffer.
requirements.impl_hint: Flags Portable|Mapped, plus hipExtHostRegisterUncached variant RCCL uses.

requirements.title: LaunchHostFunc_StreamCallback
sequence: verify cb ran after the kernel
requirements.description: Host callback enqueued in stream order — RCCL uses it for plan callbacks after launch. Verify the host fn fires in order, once.
requirements.verify: Callback observed exactly once, after the preceding kernel completed.
requirements.impl_hint: cb sets a host flag/counter; assert ordering vs kernel effect.

requirements.title: Graph_HostNode_Capture
sequence: verify host node + event ran in order
requirements.description: Explicit graph construction RCCL does for its recorder/log node: add a host node + event-record node with a dependency, run the graph.
requirements.verify: Host node callback ran during graph launch in the declared order.
requirements.impl_hint: Mirrors recorder.cc graph logging. Gate on graph API availability.

requirements.title: PointerGetAttributes_DeviceVsHost
sequence: hipMalloc dev ptr; hipHostMalloc host ptr
assert type device vs host + correct device id
requirements.description: RCCL classifies buffers via pointer attributes and address range. Covers the ROCM-2696 null-init requirement for hipMemGetAddressRange.
requirements.verify: Attributes report correct memory type/device; address range returns containing base/size; no crash.
requirements.impl_hint: base=nullptr,size=0 before hipMemGetAddressRange (ROCM-2696).

requirements.title: Memset_Sync_Async
requirements.description: Sync and stream-ordered memset floor; RCCL zero-inits buffers on both paths.
requirements.verify: Both buffers read back the set byte pattern.
requirements.impl_hint: Trivial smoke; include async-on-stream variant.

requirements.title: MallocManaged_Access
requirements.description: Unified/managed allocation accessible from host and device. RCCL uses it for an alltoallv sizes array. SKIP if managed unsupported.
requirements.verify: Host and device see each other's writes to the managed buffer.
requirements.impl_hint: hipMemAttachGlobal; gate on DirectManagedMemAccessFromHost.

requirements.title: ExtMalloc_FineGrain
sequence: kernel + host coherent updates without explicit copy
requirements.description: Fine-grained device allocation (coherent, used for signals/flags). SKIP if unsupported on the device.
requirements.verify: Coherent visibility of updates between host and device on the fine-grain buffer.
requirements.impl_hint: hipDeviceMallocFinegrained flag.

requirements.title: MemPool_SetAttribute
requirements.description: Tune a memory pool attribute then allocate from it. Extends MemPool_Alloc with the attribute-set path RCCL uses.
requirements.verify: Attribute set succeeds and pool alloc/free behaves under it.
requirements.impl_hint: SKIP if no mempool support.

requirements.title: Memcpy_AllDirections_SyncAsync
requirements.description: Acceptance floor for plain memcpy across ALL directions and both sync/async forms: HostToDevice, DeviceToDevice (RCCL's dominant path), DeviceToHost. RCCL src mostly uses D2D (collectives temp buffers) + one D2H (profile), and stages H2D via kernels/VMM rather than copy — but a HW/driver acceptance test must still confirm all three directions work, since other consumers (NIXL/rocSHMEM) and the verify paths rely on them.
requirements.verify: Each direction round-trips the byte pattern; async completes after stream sync.
requirements.impl_hint: 3 directions x {sync,async}. Distinct from Memset_Sync_Async (that is memset, this is memcpy).
requirements.provenance_hint: RCCL collectives.cc (D2D), init.cc (D2H); H2D = acceptance floor

requirements.title: Memcpy_Size_Sweep
sequence: for mode in {sync,async}: H2D + D2D(same GPU) + D2H (+ P2P if peer-capable 2nd GPU)
write position-dependent byte pattern, copy, hipStreamSynchronize (async), verify
requirements.description: Stress/scale variant of plain memcpy: sweep increasing copy sizes (1B..256MiB incl. an odd-byte size) across H2D/D2H/D2D and cross-GPU P2P, in both sync and async modes, verifying a position-dependent pattern each time. Catches size-threshold/alignment/staging-path bugs a single fixed size misses. Distinct from Memcpy_AllDirections_SyncAsync (one size vs sweep).
requirements.verify: Every (size,direction,mode) round-trips the byte pattern; P2P leg SKIPs when no peer-capable second GPU.
requirements.impl_hint: Loop sizes x {sync,async}; reuse a per-size helper (sweep_one_size). P2P leg guarded by hipDeviceCanAccessPeer + enable_peer_access_idempotent. Emit per-leg bandwidth on result.perf under --kind perf.
requirements.provenance_hint: RCCL loops device copies over varying message sizes; acceptance stress floor.
